review.scope: fifteen original right-facing Reed power-dunk poses, character identity, human anatomy, transparency, cell separation, atlas crops and runtime ball alignment
review.notes: Visual review against Reed portrait, gameplay sprite, accepted layup atlas and all packed cells preserves his medium-brown skin, dark eyes, small goatee, dark purple-black braided high topknot, natural human proportions, blank purple/gold kit, white lower-leg wear and purple/gold shoes. The sheet contains fifteen complete, distinct row-major poses with empty hands and true transparent background. Source component inspection detects fifteen separate bodies. The edit did not reach its requested 20% source-cell inset: the tightest remaining source clearance is 18.7 px (5.8% of one square cell), with no figure crossing a boundary or touching another. The component-isolated packer gives each crop independent 128x96 atlas padding. Native previews select all fifteen production frames in both facings; the ball stays carried through tick20 and releases at tick21, with the score finish at tick23.
